domains.title: Domains or URLs
domains.description: Websites to check, one per line. Full URLs and subdomains are fine: they are reduced to the registrable domain (docs.github.com becomes github.com). Up to 10,000 per run.

includeHistory.title: Include rank history and trend
includeHistory.description: Adds the daily rank for about the last month, best/worst/average rank, 7- and 30-day change and a rising/falling/stable trend. The history source allows about one domain per second, so large lists take longer.

includeSiteInfo.title: Include homepage info
includeSiteInfo.description: Visits each homepage once and adds HTTP status, final URL, HTTPS, server, response time, title, meta description and language.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel homepage checks
maxConcurrency.description: How many homepages to check at the same time when homepage info is on.
